# defectdojo_announcement (Data Source)

Data source for Defect Dojo Announcement. DefectDojo allows a single global announcement; if one already exists, import it: `terraform import defectdojo_announcement.example <id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_announcement" "example" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier

### Read-Only

- `dismissable` (Boolean) Ticking this box allows users to dismiss the current announcement
- `message` (String) This dismissable message will be displayed on all pages for authenticated users. It can contain basic html tags.
- `style` (String) The style of banner to display. (info, success, warning, danger)
